name: dino-coach
description: Self-improving Chrome Dino agent: perception heads -> priority rules -> evolved decisions

scripts.game:fetch: cd examples/dino/viewer && curl -fsSL -o game.js 'https://chromedino.com/js/game.js?v=26' && cp game.js game.orig.js && patch game.js < game.patch
scripts.publish:pages: npm run test && npm run share:inject && npm run build:pages && npm run check:leaks && git add -A docs && git commit -m "Republish pages" && git push origin main
